name: High pike
cue: Walk your feet in and keep your hips high.

name: Begin lowering
cue: Bend your elbows while keeping your hips piked.

name: Lower with control
cue: Lower your head toward the floor in front of your hands.

name: Bottom
cue: Keep your head clear of the floor and your weight through your hands.

name: Press upward
cue: Press back up while maintaining the high pike.

name: Finish pressing
cue: Straighten your arms without turning it into a regular push-up.
